validation_criteria: Statements with `Query_time` well below 2 seconds still appear in the slow log.
Logged entries show `Rows_examined` close to the table cardinality for the probe tables.
Turning `log_queries_not_using_indexes` off should stop these fast scan statements from appearing in the slow log unless they exceed `long_query_time`.
symptom_evidence: Sub-second `Query_time` values appear in the slow log.
The slow log contains repeated entries for the same query shapes.
mechanism_evidence: The probe queries are full scans because `tag` has no index.
